prespecified_units.measure: Presence of malaria parasites on thick blood smear in children 1-60 months
prespecified_units.role_evidence_quote: The prespecified primary malaria outcome was the presence or absence of at least 1 parasite on thick blood smear in children 1 to 59 months of age, assessed as a community-level prevalence.
prespecified_units.result_quote: Parasitemia prevalence was significantly lower in the azithromycin group at months 12 and 24 after adjusting for baseline parasitemia and the date of sample collection ( P = 0.02; ICC = 0.26; square-root-transformed outcome; prespecified primary outcome).

additional_units.result_quote: In this cluster randomized clinical trial of 4726 children in 30 communities in Niger, communities with hypoendemic trachoma in which azithromycin was distributed biannually to children aged 1 to 59 months had a slightly lower prevalence of trachomatous inflammation-follicular and trachomatous inflammation-intense relative to communities treated with biannual placebo, but the difference was not statistically significant.

additional_units.reported_instrument: multiplex bead assay performed on the Bio-plex 200 instrument equipped with the Bio-Plex manager software, version 6.0 (Bio-Rad)
additional_units.role_evidence_quote: A secondary outcome was the seroprevalence of antibodies to C trachomatis antigens.
additional_units.result_quote: The mean pgp3 seroprevalence among children aged 12 to 59 months at baseline was 0.6% (95% CI, 0-1.3%) in the azithromycin group and 0.6% (95% CI, 0-1.1%) in the placebo group (eTable 3 in Supplement 2 ).

additional_units.reported_instrument: multiplex bead assay performed on the Bio-plex 200 instrument equipped with the Bio-Plex manager software, version 6.0 (Bio-Rad)
additional_units.role_evidence_quote: A secondary outcome was the seroprevalence of antibodies to C trachomatis antigens.
additional_units.result_quote: At month 24, pgp3 seroprevalence was 0.4% (95% CI, 0-1.0%) in the azithromycin group and 0.6% (95% CI, 0-1.3%) in the placebo group (incidence rate ratio adjusted for baseline, 0.71 [95% CI, 0.09-4.30]; permutation P  = .87).

additional_units.role_evidence_quote: Every 6 months, a single dose of either oral azithromycin (20 mg/kg using height-based approximation for children who could stand or weight calculation for small children) or oral placebo was provided to all children aged 1 to 59 months.
additional_units.result_quote: During the 4 biannual treatment visits, the study drug was administered to a mean of 79% (95% CI, 75%-83%) of children in the azithromycin group and 82% (95% CI, 79%-85%) of children in the placebo group ( Figure 1 ).

additional_units.role_evidence_quote: Participants were instructed to report adverse events to designated village representatives.
additional_units.result_quote: No hospitalizations or life-threatening illnesses were reported in either group.
